decisions: Minutes from the March 18, 2025 board meeting approved as amended with unanimous consent.
Q1 2025 financial report approved; Pierre Dubois authorized to initiate a formal review of all vendor contracts exceeding $50,000 annually, with findings due at the May board meeting.

Northwind Partners scope expansion unanimously approved; Aiyana Park to finalize amended service agreement by April 30, 2025; HR to begin recruitment for one specialist consultant immediately; Pierre Dubois to prepare revised budget allocation by May 5, 2025.
Monday.com Business adopted as the firm-wide project management platform; Aiyana Park authorized to execute procurement up to $35,000 for year one; deployment memo to be issued by May 1, 2025.

Salary adjustment pool of up to $180,000 approved for senior associates and consultants, effective July 1, 2025; Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park to develop a performance bonus framework proposal for the June 2025 board meeting.
Next board meeting scheduled for May 20, 2025 at 9:00 AM; Margaret Holvan to circulate draft agenda by May 13, 2025.
